stem:
In her house in Jaipur, Meena watches four different moving things during the day.
Which one shows oscillatory motion, that is, motion to and fro about a fixed position?

options.text: A ceiling fan blade going round and round
The pendulum of an old wall clock swinging about its rest position
A ball rolling down the playground slide
A cycle moving straight along the road to school

teacher.key_rationale: Only the clock pendulum moves to and fro about a fixed (rest) position, which defines oscillatory motion. The fan blade is circular (periodic but not to-and-fro about a fixed position), and the ball and cycle are non-repeating translatory motions.
